153.long_description:
We are getting very close to having the 29 inch arcade monitors available for pre-order next month as we have recently changed hardware and with this, have needed to updated our monitor firmware. 

Our 29.3inch is a 4:3 aspect ratio monitor with low display lag times, that allows native 15/24/25/31khz traditional arcade game boards to be used on "plug and play basis". However, it also supports resolutions up to 1080P (recommended resolution is 1600x1200) via either VGA or HDMI input. 

We will share more news via our social media channels over these next weeks.

In the below photos, the first image shows arcade board mismatch with the screen not centred and with black boards. For the second image, with updated firmware, it shows as full and centred image.
